purpose: Test one coefficient-free safety correction to V113: retain the admitted-work clearance objective, but accept a critical substitution only when the processor-sharing interference imposed on already-admitted work is nonworse than on the anchor node.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v113_only_failure: Sustained-burst mean throughput was 0.1623% below the anchor because E909 lost two fixed-window completions while E910 gained one; all six QPR gates and both other throughput gates passed.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v113_supported_effects: Spike throughput/QPR improved 0.792%/4.485%, sustained QPR improved 2.843%, and pulse throughput/QPR improved 3.825%/9.294%.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.safety_gap: V113 minimizes the current critical player's admitted-work clearance proxy. It does not separately certify the extra equal-share CPU delay that placing that player on a node imposes on work already admitted there.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: A coefficient-free componentwise Pareto certificate for admitted-work processor-sharing interference; no threshold, weight, cap, horizon, service ratio, scenario label, or result-derived margin is introduced.

frozen_parent_profiles.temporal_and_service_certificate: 50-frame 3/2 causal activation with maximum candidate-to-anchor admitted-work service proxy ratio 9/10

closed_axes.causal_horizon_refitting: 25 and 50 tested in V109; V114 fixes 50
closed_axes.critical_service_ratio_refitting: 9/10 and 4/5 tested in V108; V114 fixes 9/10
closed_axes.arrival_rate_threshold_refitting: 3/2 and 2/1 tested in V107; V114 fixes 3/2

hypothesis.primary: V113's admitted-work objective captures node clearance and produced broad throughput/QPR gains, but a substitution can still delay already-admitted short work under equal-share CPU service. A nonworse interference Pareto constraint should remove that failure mode without fitting a margin.
hypothesis.candidate: Retain every V113 choice and complete-assignment certificate. Additionally compute, for the current player work w, the sum of min(existing_work,w) over pending immutable work, all resident remaining work, and earlier same-window projected immutable work, divided by node capacity; require candidate interference no greater than anchor interference both per choice and in the complete critical-player replay.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E911-E913 cohort.

allowed: the frozen V109 first-seen request history, 3/2 shock certificate, and 50-frame activation deadline
the immutable raw CPU of every assigned-but-not-resident pending task
the current finite nonnegative RunningTask.left_calc of every task already resident in a node container, regardless of its current cold-start, parent, or data gate
the immutable raw CPU of functions already assigned in the current deterministic scheduling window and of the current player
every immutable and current-state V113 locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and critical-frontier input
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, or registered burst interval as a routing input
E899-E910 result-dependent threshold, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap multiplier, or scenario refitting
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.arrival_and_activation_definition: Bit-for-bit V109 horizon50: 80-frame baseline, 20-frame recent first-seen ReqId history, at least 20 requests in each, exact 3/2 integer comparison, deadline current_frame+49.
information_boundary.admitted_work_definition: Bit-for-bit V113: pending Func.cpu plus every resident RunningTask.left_calc plus earlier same-window projected Func.cpu plus current-player Func.cpu, each counted exactly once in stable order.
information_boundary.interference_definition: For current-player immutable work w and node capacity C, sum min(x,w)/C over every pending immutable CPU value, every resident remaining CPU value, and every earlier same-window projected immutable CPU value. This deterministic conservative certificate represents equal-share service that admitted work can consume before the current player completes.
information_boundary.candidate_interference_certificate: The interference definition evaluated on the candidate node and the same pre-current-player AssignmentState; it must be no greater than the anchor certificate.
information_boundary.complete_assignment_certificate: Replay critical players in frozen order and require the alternative total admitted-work proxy to be strictly lower and its total interference certificate to be no greater than the anchor total.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any missing task/function, non-finite or negative work, invalid capacity/bandwidth, incomplete parent placement, count mismatch, or arithmetic overflow makes either certificate unavailable and preserves the anchor assignment.

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: Add componentwise and complete-assignment nonworsening admitted-work interference certificates to V113; every V113 objective, input, ratio, and non-work gate is unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.eligible_players_and_certificates: Bit-for-bit V113, plus candidate interference no greater than anchor per critical choice and alternative total critical interference no greater than anchor after complete deterministic replay.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without sufficient history, an active horizon, complete work snapshots, or both admitted-work and interference certificates, dispatch exact V94 for identical current state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V113 causal-arrival, admitted-work, and critical-service fields
anchor and selected per-choice interference, complete anchor and alternative interference sums, rejection and unavailable counters
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V114 profile
